newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QBE says Sept qtr profit A$28.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QBE says Sept qtr profit A$28.5 mln.

text.p: QBE Insurance Ltd said on Tuesday it reported a net profit of A$28.5 million for the September quarter and that it expects further profit growth in the 1996/97 financial year.

"The directors are pleased to announce that, using the seven year spread basis, the unaudited accounts for the first quarter of the 1996/97 financial year indicate a good start with a net profit after tax of A$28.5 million, slightly up on the same period last year," QBE said.
QBE said unrealised gains on investments net of tax fell A$1.6 million in the quarter, producing a profit after tax in accordance with the current accounting standard of A$25.9 million.

"Further unrealised equity gains have emerged since the end of the quarter, in line with the upward trend of the Australian stock market," QBE managing director John Cloney told the company's annual meeting.
"In the absence of unusual frequency or severity of claims or a decline in investments markets, the directors are expecting further profit growth in 1996/97 financial year," Cloney said.
QBE reported a net profit of A$147.3 million in the year to June 30, 1996, after unrealised gains on investments of A$40.2 million, and up from A$82.5 million in 1994/95.
QBE shares were eight cents firmer at A$6.63 at 12.15 p.m. (0115 GMT).
